seoDescription: Write to Max-Morrys: a course and the community, or a website and platform project. Marketing-direction engagements are contracted by MY ONOMA. Dakar, Senegal.

page.lede: A question about a course, a shop to put online, an idea for an episode. I'm the one who reads, and I'm the one who answers — give it two working days.

route.question: What is this about?
route.learnBody: A course, an access problem, the Digitos Club, the blog, an episode.
route.buildBody: A shop to put online, a custom project to scope.
route.growBody: Acquisition, revenue, a brand strategy to run.

myonoma.title: This request goes to MY ONOMA.
myonoma.body: Marketing direction, acquisition and revenue are not carried by Max-Morrys: MY ONOMA contracts them, through its own practice. So I don't collect your request here to copy it over there by hand — you write it straight to the right place, and you keep a single conversation.
myonoma.note: Outbound link: you are leaving maxmorrys.me.

account.title: You're writing from your account
account.body: My answer will arrive in your space, and this message will stay in your inbox.

form.subjectLabel: What do you want to talk about?
form.messagePlaceholderLearn: Tell me where you are and what you're trying to do…
form.messagePlaceholderBuild: Describe the shop or the project, and what already exists online…
form.note: You can write without an account too — but then I can't answer you inside the app.

truth.title: What happens to your message
truth.body: From a signed-in account, the message is attached to that account: it stays in your inbox, and my answer lands in the same place. Without an account it stays anonymous inside the app — I then answer by hand, at the address left in the form.
